description: A modern, multi-level spiral staircase enclosed in glass and topped with a white canopy. Each level features a square wooden platform with a curved edge, supported by white columns. The spiral stairs themselves are made of wood and metal, creating a sleek and open design. The structure is set on a large, light-wood plank floor, suggesting an outdoor or architectural element. The transparent glass walls allow for unobstructed views, making it feel light and airy. This design emphasizes clean lines and a minimalist aesthetic.
